metadata.description: Webhook integration skills for AI coding agents: provider skills (Stripe, Shopify, GitHub, and 802 others) plus framework-agnostic handler patterns and Hookdeck infrastructure plugins for receiving, verifying, and delivering webhooks across Express, Next.js, and FastAPI.

plugins.name: 100ms-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate 100ms webhooks. Use when setting up a 100ms (live video) webhook endpoint, checking the secret header you configure in the 100ms dashboard, debugging 401s, or handling events like peer.join.success, peer.leave.success, session.open.success, session.close.success, recording.success and hls.started.success.

plugins.name: 360dialog-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate 360dialog WhatsApp Business API webhooks. Use when setting up a 360dialog webhook endpoint, adding HTTP Basic auth to the webhook headers, debugging 401s, or handling inbound messages, message status updates (sent, delivered, read, failed) and Coexistence events such as smb_message_echoes.

plugins.name: 8x8-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate 8x8 Connect webhooks. Use when setting up an 8x8 webhook endpoint, checking the optional HTTP Authorization value (Bearer or Basic), debugging 401s, or handling inbound_message_received, outbound_message_status_changed, short_url_clicked and template_status_update events from 8x8 SMS and Chat Apps (WhatsApp).

plugins.name: ably-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Ably webhooks (outbound HTTP integration rules). Use when setting up Ably webhook handlers, debugging X-Ably-Signature verification, or handling channel.message, channel.presence, channel.lifecycle and channel.occupancy events, including batched, enveloped and msgpack payloads.

plugins.name: absorb-lms-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Absorb LMS webhooks. Use when setting up an Absorb LMS webhook endpoint, verifying the absorb-signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body), debugging signature failures on Test Webhook requests, or handling events like UserCreated, CertificateAwarded and EnrollmentCompletedbyAdmin.

plugins.name: act-on-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Act-On outgoing webhooks (marketing automation, delivered through Svix). Use when setting up Act-On webhook handlers, debugging Svix signature verification (svix-id, svix-timestamp, svix-signature, whsec_ Signing Secret), telling events apart when the payload has no event type, or handling contact.added, contact.updated, contact-bounce.hard, form.submitted, contact-opt.global-opt-out, automated-program.started and subscription-category.opt-in events.

plugins.name: acuity-scheduling-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Acuity Scheduling webhooks. Use when setting up Acuity Scheduling webhook handlers, debugging X-Acuity-Signature verification, or handling appointment actions like scheduled, rescheduled, canceled, changed, and order.completed.

plugins.name: acumatica-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Acumatica push notification webhooks. Use when setting up an Acumatica (MYOB Acumatica) Webhook destination on the Push Notifications form, checking the secret header you configured, debugging 401s, or handling Inserted and Deleted row changes from a monitored generic inquiry.

plugins.name: ada-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Ada (ada.cx) AI customer service webhooks, delivered through Svix. Use when setting up an Ada webhook endpoint, getting the per-endpoint whsec_ signing secret, debugging svix-id / svix-timestamp / svix-signature verification, or handling events like v1.conversation.created, v1.conversation.message, v1.conversation.ended, v1.conversation.handoff.ended, v1.end_user.created, v1.end_user.updated, v1.audit_log.emitted and v1.proactive_call.* voice outreach events.

plugins.name: adyen-webhooks
plugins.description: Verify Adyen webhook HMAC signatures (additionalData.hmacSignature, HMAC-SHA256), handle AUTHORISATION, CAPTURE, and REFUND notifications.

plugins.name: affonso-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Affonso affiliate-program webhooks. Use when setting up Affonso webhook handlers, debugging X-Affonso-Signature verification, or handling events like affiliate.created, referral.converted, transaction.created, transaction.paid, and payout.paid.

plugins.name: aftership-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify AfterShip webhooks. Use when setting up AfterShip webhook handlers, debugging AfterShip signature verification (aftership-hmac-sha256, as-signature-hmac-sha256, am-webhook-signature), or handling AfterShip Tracking events like tracking_update, edd_revise and tracking_pending_time, AfterShip Returns events like return.approved, AfterShip Warranty events like warranty.created, and AfterShip Shipping (Postmen) events like create_a_label.

plugins.name: agentcard-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Agentcard webhooks. Use when setting up Agentcard virtual card webhook handlers, debugging AgentCard-Signature verification, or handling events such as card.created, card.updated, card.closed, transaction.authorized, approval.requested, checkout_authorization.approved, and balance.low.

plugins.name: agentline-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify AgentLine webhooks. Use when setting up AgentLine (AI phone agent) webhook handlers, debugging X-Webhook-Signature verification, or handling events like call.received, call.utterance, call.completed and sms.received.

plugins.name: agentmail-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify AgentMail webhooks (email inboxes for AI agents). Use when setting up AgentMail webhook handlers, debugging Svix signature verification (svix-id, svix-timestamp, svix-signature, whsec_ secret), deduplicating on event_id, or handling events like message.received, message.sent, message.delivered, message.bounced, message.complained, message.rejected, message.opened, message.security.review, domain.verified and calendar.event.starting.

plugins.name: agentset-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Agentset webhooks (managed RAG platform). Use when setting up an Agentset webhook endpoint, verifying the agentset-signature header, debugging 401s, or handling document.ready, document.error and ingest_job.ready events.

plugins.name: agntix-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Agntix webhooks (voice and chat AI-agent platform, delivered by Svix). Use when setting up Agntix webhook handlers, debugging svix-signature verification, or handling the session.created and session.ended events with post-call analysis.

plugins.name: agora-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Agora webhooks (Agora Notifications / NCS). Use when setting up Agora webhook handlers, debugging Agora-Signature verification, or handling RTC channel events such as channel create (101), channel destroy (102) and broadcaster join (103).

plugins.name: aimfox-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Aimfox webhooks. Use when setting up an Aimfox webhook endpoint, checking the Authentication Header, debugging 401s, or handling LinkedIn automation events like new_connection, accepted, new_reply, message and account_logged_out.

plugins.name: aiprise-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify AiPrise webhooks (callbacks). Use when setting up AiPrise identity/KYC/KYB callback handlers, debugging X-HMAC-SIGNATURE verification, or handling verification results like APPROVED, DECLINED, REVIEW, and UNKNOWN.

plugins.name: aircall-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Aircall webhooks. Use when setting up Aircall webhook handlers, debugging Aircall webhook token verification, or handling Aircall cloud phone events like call.created, call.answered, call.ended, message.received, contact.updated, or user.connected.v2. Aircall does NOT use an HMAC signature — verification is a timing-safe comparison of the `token` field inside the JSON body.

plugins.name: airtable-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Airtable webhooks. Use when setting up Airtable webhook handlers, debugging X-Airtable-Content-MAC signature verification, handling the thin-ping notification, or fetching base changes (tableData, tableFields, tableMetadata add/remove/update) from the webhook payloads API.

plugins.name: airwallex-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Airwallex webhooks. Use when setting up Airwallex webhook handlers, debugging x-signature / x-timestamp signature verification, or handling payment events like payment_intent.succeeded, payment_attempt.paid, refund.settled, payment_consent.verified, or payment_dispute.requires_response.

plugins.name: airweave-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Airweave webhooks (open-source context-retrieval layer, delivered via Svix). Use when setting up Airweave webhook handlers, debugging svix-signature verification, or handling events like sync.completed, sync.failed, source_connection.auth_completed, and collection.deleted.

plugins.name: akeneo-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Akeneo PIM (Events API) webhooks. Use when setting up Akeneo webhook handlers, debugging x-akeneo-request-signature verification, or handling batched product and product-model events like product.created, product.updated, product.removed, product_model.created, product_model.updated, or product_model.removed.

plugins.name: alchemy-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Alchemy Notify webhooks. Use when setting up Alchemy webhook handlers, debugging X-Alchemy-Signature verification, or handling onchain events like ADDRESS_ACTIVITY, NFT_ACTIVITY, or GRAPHQL (Custom Webhook).

plugins.name: alipay-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Alipay (Antom / Alipay+) webhook notifications. Use when setting up Alipay webhook handlers, debugging RSA256 Signature header verification, or handling payment events like notifyPayment, notifyCapture, notifyRefund, notifyAuthorization, and notifyDispute.

plugins.name: ampersand-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Ampersand webhooks (delivered through Svix). Use when setting up an Ampersand webhook destination, debugging svix-signature verification, or handling notifications such as installation.created, connection.error, read.backfill.done and write.async.done, and read or subscribe result payloads.

plugins.name: amplitude-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Amplitude webhooks (the Webhook streaming destination). Use when setting up an Amplitude webhook endpoint, checking the secret header you add to the destination, debugging 401s, or handling forwarded events and user property updates.

plugins.name: anarlog-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Anarlog webhooks. Use when setting up Anarlog webhook handlers, debugging x-anarlog-signature verification, or handling meeting.completed and note.enhanced events from the Anarlog meeting notes app.

plugins.name: api-video-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify api.video webhooks. Use when setting up api.video webhook handlers, debugging X-Api-Video-Signature verification, or handling video and live stream events like video.source.recorded, video.encoding.quality.completed, live-stream.broadcast.started and live-stream.broadcast.ended.

plugins.name: apify-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Apify webhooks. Use when setting up an Apify webhook endpoint, adding a secret header with the Headers template, debugging 401s, or handling Actor run and build events like ACTOR.RUN.SUCCEEDED, ACTOR.RUN.FAILED and ACTOR.BUILD.SUCCEEDED.

plugins.name: appsflyer-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate AppsFlyer Push API (raw data streaming) webhooks. Use when setting up an AppsFlyer Push API endpoint, debugging the custom authorization header AppsFlyer sends, or handling raw-data records such as install and in-app events like af_purchase. AppsFlyer does not sign payloads: there is no signature header or HMAC.

plugins.name: appstle-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Appstle Subscriptions webhooks (delivered via Svix). Use when setting up Appstle webhook handlers, debugging svix-signature verification, or handling subscription events like subscription.created, subscription.cancelled, subscription.billing-success, and subscription.billing-failure.

plugins.name: arcadia-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Arcadia webhooks (utility data platform, Plug and Spark APIs). Use when setting up an Arcadia webhook endpoint, checking the custom authentication header Arcadia support configures, debugging 401s, or handling STATUS_CHANGE, NEW_DATA_AVAILABLE, EXISTING_DATA_UPDATED, DATA_DELETED and credential validation events.

plugins.name: ardoq-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Ardoq webhooks. Use when setting up an Ardoq webhook handler, debugging X-Ardoq-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, or handling component, reference and tag change events from an Ardoq enterprise-architecture organization.

plugins.name: argil-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Argil (argil.ai) AI avatar video webhooks, signed per Standard Webhooks. Use when setting up an Argil webhook endpoint, getting the whsec_ signing secret from POST /webhooks, debugging webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature verification, or handling VIDEO_GENERATION_SUCCESS, VIDEO_GENERATION_FAILED, AVATAR_TRAINING_SUCCESS and AVATAR_TRAINING_FAILED events.

plugins.name: argo-cd-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Argo CD notification webhooks. Use when setting up an endpoint for the Argo CD Notifications webhook service, adding a secret header in argocd-notifications-cm, handling GET or POST requests with an empty or templated body, or debugging 401s for sync-succeeded and health-degraded notifications.

plugins.name: argyle-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Argyle webhooks. Use when setting up an Argyle webhook subscription handler, debugging X-Argyle-Signature (HMAC-SHA512) verification failures, or handling payroll and income verification events such as accounts.connected, accounts.failed and gigs.fully_synced.

plugins.name: asaas-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Asaas (Brazilian payments) webhooks. Use when setting up Asaas webhook handlers, debugging the asaas-access-token header or authToken check, or handling payment events like PAYMENT_CREATED, PAYMENT_RECEIVED, PAYMENT_CONFIRMED, and PAYMENT_OVERDUE.

plugins.name: asana-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Asana webhooks. Use when setting up Asana webhook handlers, implementing the X-Hook-Secret handshake, debugging X-Hook-Signature verification, or handling task, project, and story events like added, changed, removed, deleted, and undeleted.

plugins.name: ascend-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Ascend webhooks. Use when setting up Ascend webhook handlers, debugging Ascend signature verification (X-Ascend-Signature, HMAC-SHA256), or handling insurance payment events like invoice.paid, payout.paid, and refund.paid.

plugins.name: ashby-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Ashby webhooks. Use when setting up Ashby webhook handlers, debugging Ashby-Signature verification, or handling recruiting events like applicationSubmit, candidateHire, candidateStageChange, or interviewScheduleCreate.

plugins.name: assemblyai-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate AssemblyAI transcript webhooks. Use when setting up an AssemblyAI webhook endpoint, checking the webhook_auth_header_name / webhook_auth_header_value header, debugging 401s on deliveries, or handling completed and error transcript statuses.

plugins.name: athenahealth-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify athenahealth webhooks (Event Subscription Platform, FHIR Subscription notifications). Use when setting up athenahealth webhook handlers, debugging X-Hub-Signature verification, or handling topics like Appointment.schedule, Appointment.cancel, Encounter.signoff, and LabResult.create.

plugins.name: attentive-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Attentive webhooks. Use when setting up Attentive webhook handlers, debugging signature verification (x-attentive-hmac-sha256), or handling SMS and email events like sms.subscribed, sms.unsubscribed, email.opened, or custom_attribute.set.

plugins.name: attio-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Attio CRM webhooks. Use when setting up Attio webhook handlers, debugging Attio-Signature verification, deduplicating with the Idempotency-Key header, or handling Attio events like record.created, record.updated, list-entry.created, note.created, and task.created.

plugins.name: aurora-solar-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Aurora Solar webhooks. Use when setting up an Aurora Solar webhook endpoint, checking the header_auth_key token header, reading event data from the query string of GET requests, debugging 401s, or handling events like project_created, design_created, project_status_changed and performance_simulation_job_completed.

plugins.name: auth0-webhooks
plugins.description: Authenticate Auth0 Custom Log Stream deliveries (Authorization token), handle batched login and signup log events.

plugins.name: authgear-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Authgear webhooks. Use when configuring Authgear webhook endpoints, debugging x-authgear-body-signature signatures, or handling user.created, user.authenticated, user.deleted.

plugins.name: autosana-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Autosana webhooks. Use when setting up Autosana webhook handlers, debugging X-Autosana-Signature-256 signature verification, or handling the batch.completed event sent when a batch of AI mobile app test flow runs finishes.

plugins.name: autotask-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Autotask PSA webhooks (Datto, now Kaseya). Use when setting up Autotask webhook handlers, debugging X-Hook-Signature verification, or handling Company, Contact, Ticket and TicketNote Create, Update, Delete and Deactivated callouts.

plugins.name: autumn-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Autumn webhooks (pricing and billing for AI apps). Use when setting up Autumn webhook handlers, debugging Svix signature verification (svix-id, svix-timestamp, svix-signature, whsec_ secret), handling retries that fail the 5-minute timestamp window, or handling events like billing.updated, balances.limit_reached, balances.usage_alert_triggered, billing.auto_topup_failed and invoice.finalized.

plugins.name: auvik-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Auvik webhooks. Use when setting up an Auvik alert webhook endpoint (MSP dashboard Webhook integration), checking the custom header used for Header authentication, debugging 401s, or handling Triggered and Cleared network alerts.

plugins.name: aws-eventbridge-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Amazon EventBridge API destination webhooks. Use when setting up an endpoint that EventBridge calls from a rule or pipe, checking the Basic Authorization header, debugging 401s, or handling events by source and detail-type such as EC2 Instance State-change Notification.

plugins.name: aws-sns-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify AWS SNS (Amazon Simple Notification Service) webhooks over HTTP/HTTPS. Use when setting up an SNS HTTP subscription endpoint, confirming a subscription (SubscriptionConfirmation / SubscribeURL), verifying SNS message signatures (SigningCertURL, SignatureVersion 1 SHA1 / 2 SHA256), or handling Notification and UnsubscribeConfirmation messages.

plugins.name: axilio-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Axilio webhooks (real-phone automation), signed with the Standard Webhooks scheme. Use when setting up an Axilio webhook destination, getting the whsec_ signing secret, debugging webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature verification, or handling events like run.completed, run.failed, session.ended, balance.low, invoice.payment_failed, file.ready and phone.offline.

plugins.name: axiom-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Axiom monitor webhooks. Use when setting up an Axiom Custom webhook notifier endpoint, checking a secret header (Axiom does not sign requests), debugging 401s, or handling monitor notifications with action Open and Closed.

plugins.name: ayrshare-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Ayrshare webhooks. Use when setting up Ayrshare social media API webhook handlers, debugging X-Authorization-Content-SHA256-V2 signature verification, rotating the signing secret, or handling scheduled, social, messages, comments, mentions and ads actions.

plugins.name: azure-devops-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Azure DevOps webhooks (Web Hooks service hooks). Use when setting up an Azure DevOps service hook endpoint, verifying the basic authentication credentials, debugging 401s, or handling events like git.push, git.pullrequest.created, git.pullrequest.merged, workitem.created, workitem.updated and build.complete.

plugins.name: azure-event-grid-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and validate Azure Event Grid webhook deliveries. Use when setting up an Event Grid WebHook event handler, implementing the Microsoft.EventGrid.SubscriptionValidationEvent handshake (echo data.validationCode as validationResponse with HTTP 200), implementing the CloudEvents v1.0 HTTP OPTIONS abuse-protection preflight (WebHook-Request-Origin / WebHook-Allowed-Origin), checking the aeg-subscription-name / aeg-event-type / aeg-delivery-count headers, authenticating deliveries with a static delivery-property header or a Microsoft Entra ID bearer token, parsing Event Grid schema arrays vs CloudEvents objects, or handling events like Microsoft.Storage.BlobCreated. Event Grid does NOT sign the request body — there is no HMAC signature.

plugins.name: azure-logic-apps-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate webhook calls from an Azure Logic Apps (or Power Automate) HTTP action. Use when building an endpoint a Logic Apps workflow calls, checking Basic authentication (Authorization: Basic base64(username:password)), Raw authentication or a shared-secret header with a constant-time compare, debugging 401s from a Logic App, or handling the workflow's JSON payload. Logic Apps does not sign requests: there is no signature header and no event types.

plugins.name: bamboohr-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify BambooHR webhooks, both Event-Based (employee.created, employee.updated, employee.deleted, company.*) and Field-Based (the batched employees payload with Created, Updated and Deleted actions). Use when setting up BambooHR webhook handlers or debugging X-BambooHR-Signature verification.

plugins.name: baselinker-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive BaseLinker (Base.com) webhooks. Use when building a BaseLinker order or warehouse callback receiver, because BaseLinker is not a normal webhook source: deliveries arrive as HTTP HEAD requests with NO body, the entire payload is in the query string (observed params: order_id, state), there is NO signature verification of any kind (no HMAC, no secret, no handshake), and your response must be a bare bodyless 200. Use when debugging an empty req.body, wiring app.head / an exported HEAD route handler / @app.head, or polling getJournalList for change tracking.

plugins.name: baserow-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Baserow webhooks. Use when setting up a Baserow table webhook endpoint, authenticating the custom secret header, debugging 401s, or handling events like rows.created, rows.updated, rows.deleted, view.created and field.updated.

plugins.name: baseten-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Baseten webhooks. Use when setting up Baseten async inference callbacks (webhook_endpoint on /async_predict), debugging X-BASETEN-SIGNATURE verification, or handling async_request_completed events.

plugins.name: basin-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Basin form backend webhooks. Use when setting up Basin webhook handlers, debugging X-Basin-Signature verification, or handling form submissions delivered as JSON or form-urlencoded webhook payloads.

plugins.name: basiq-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Basiq (basiq.io, Australian open banking / CDR data API) webhooks. Use when setting up a Basiq webhook endpoint, creating a webhook subscription, debugging webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature (Standard Webhooks) verification with a whsec_ secret, or handling events like user.created, connection.activated, consent.revoked, consent.expired, account.updated and transactions.updated.

plugins.name: bayou-energy-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Bayou Energy (bayou.energy) utility-data webhooks, signed per the Standard Webhooks spec. Use when setting up a Bayou webhook endpoint, getting the company whsec_ signing secret, debugging webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature verification, or handling events like new_bill, updated_bill, bills_ready, intervals_ready, customer_has_filled_credentials, new_unparsed_bill and customer_must_reauthenticate.

plugins.name: beehiiv-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify beehiiv newsletter platform webhooks, delivered through Svix. Use when setting up a beehiiv webhook endpoint, debugging svix-id / svix-timestamp / svix-signature verification (whsec_ secret), or handling events like subscription.created, subscription.upgraded, post.sent, post.scheduled, newsletter_list_subscription.subscribed and survey.response_submitted.

plugins.name: belco-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Belco webhooks. Use when setting up Belco (belco.io) webhook handlers, debugging x-hook-signature verification, or handling call and conversation events like conversation.created, conversation.closed and call.answered.

plugins.name: belvo-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Belvo open finance webhooks. Use when setting up a Belvo webhook endpoint for Payments (Mexico/Brazil) or Aggregation, checking the optional Authorization header (Bearer or Basic), debugging 401s, or handling events like payment_request_successful, payment_request_failed, consent_confirmed, customer_blocked and historical_update.

plugins.name: better-stack-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Better Stack (Uptime / incident management) outgoing webhooks. Use when setting up an incident, monitor or on-call change webhook, checking the Basic auth or custom header credential, debugging 401s, or handling incident comment, resolved and on-call change notifications. Better Stack does not sign webhooks.

plugins.name: bigcommerce-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify BigCommerce webhooks. Use when setting up BigCommerce webhook handlers, debugging Standard Webhooks signature verification, or handling store events like store/order/created, store/order/statusUpdated, store/product/updated, or store/cart/abandoned.

plugins.name: bigmailer-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify BigMailer webhooks. Use when setting up BigMailer webhook handlers, debugging X-BigMailer-Signature verification, or handling email engagement events like bounce, click, complaint, open, and unsubscribe.

plugins.name: bindbee-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Bindbee webhooks (unified HRIS, ATS and LMS API, version 2). Use when setting up a Bindbee webhook handler, debugging webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature verification, or handling events such as connector.linked, connector.sync.completed, connector.relink_needed and hris.employee.created.

plugins.name: bird-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Bird (bird.com, formerly MessageBird) webhooks, which follow the Standard Webhooks spec. Use when setting up a Bird webhook endpoint, getting the whsec_ signing secret, debugging webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature verification, rotating the secret, or handling events like email.delivered, email.bounced, email.complained, whatsapp.received, preference.granted and preference.revoked.

plugins.name: bitbucket-webhooks
plugins.description: Verify Bitbucket webhook signatures (X-Hub-Signature, HMAC-SHA256), handle repo push and pull request events.

plugins.name: bitculator-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Bitculator webhooks. Use when setting up Bitculator webhook handlers, debugging X-Bitculator-Signature verification, or handling the alarm.triggered price alarm event from the Bitculator crypto market data API.

plugins.name: bitdefender-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Bitdefender GravityZone Event Push webhooks. Use when setting up a Bitdefender jsonRPC push endpoint with setPushEventSettings, checking the Authorization header credential, debugging 401s, or handling addEvents notifications such as av, aph, avc, fw, hd and dp events.

plugins.name: bitrise-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Bitrise outgoing webhooks. Use when setting up a Bitrise webhook endpoint, checking a secret custom header, debugging 401s, or handling CI build events and Release Management events like app_version_added, testflight_upload_completed and google_play_upload_completed.

plugins.name: bland-ai-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Bland AI webhooks (AI phone calls). Use when setting up a Bland post-call webhook endpoint, creating the webhook signing secret, debugging X-Webhook-Signature (HMAC-SHA256) verification failures, or handling post-call payloads with call_id, status, transcripts, citations and post_transfer_transcript.

plugins.name: blindpay-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify BlindPay webhooks (stablecoin and fiat payins/payouts API, delivered via Svix). Use when setting up BlindPay webhook handlers, debugging svix-signature verification, or handling events like payin.complete, payout.complete, customer.update, transfer.complete and wallet.inbound.

plugins.name: boldsign-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify BoldSign webhooks. Use when setting up BoldSign e-signature webhook handlers, debugging X-BoldSign-Signature verification, answering the Verification event during webhook setup, or handling events like Sent, Viewed, Signed, Completed, Declined, Revoked, and Expired.

plugins.name: bolt-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Bolt checkout (boltapp.com) webhooks. Use when setting up Bolt webhook handlers, debugging X-Bolt-Hmac-Sha256 signature verification, or handling transaction events like payment, capture, credit, void, auth, pending, and rejected_irreversible.

plugins.name: box-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and verify Box V2 webhooks. Use when setting up Box webhook handlers, debugging BOX-SIGNATURE-PRIMARY verification, or handling events like FILE.UPLOADED, FILE.DOWNLOADED, FILE.TRASHED, FOLDER.CREATED, COMMENT.CREATED, COLLABORATION.CREATED, and SIGN_REQUEST.COMPLETED.

plugins.name: braze-webhooks
plugins.description: Receive and authenticate Braze webhooks. Use when setting up an endpoint for Braze webhook campaigns, Canvas webhook steps or webhook templates, verifying the Basic authentication credential Braze sends, debugging 401s, or handling the JSON or raw text request bodies your messages compose.
